name: Ruleforge V5 Playtest Smoke Scenario
description: Creates a tiny, isolated diagnostics marker for supervised Ruleforge playtest checks.

steps.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local SmokeSignal = Remotes:WaitForChild("RuleforgeSmokeSignal")

local function report()
	print(("[RuleforgeSmokeReporter] players=%d matchEnded=%s primaryFireInterval=%s"):format(#Players:GetPlayers(), tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("MatchEnded")), tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("PrimaryFireInterval"))))
	SmokeSignal:FireAllClients({
		players = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		matchEnded = workspace:GetAttribute("MatchEnded"),
	})
end

report()
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(report)
